Rdragmap

Source: R/Rdragmap-package.R
Rdragmap-package.Rd

A source-built R wrapper for the portable, history-preserving DRAGMAP fork. It builds and invokes one package-owned dragen-os executable through an explicit argument vector. It does not search PATH and does not expose the native implementation archives as an R ABI.
